data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 's-f-r', meaning 'to split, rush, or fly'. In Islamic tradition, Isaf is a name given to those who are quick, nimble, and agile. The name Isaf carries the meaning “The Swift One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Isaf usually hope their child will grow to embody the swift one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
